At Rimech Engineering Pty Ltd, we deliver turnkey Structural, Mechanical, and Piping (SMP) solutions across Western Australia with a strong foundation built on ISO-aligned compliance and data-driven project management.

Rimech Engineering are currently looking to fill the following roles:
- Metal Fabricators / Fitters
- Construction Estimator

Metal Fabricators/Fitters: To be considered for this opportunity, you will need to hold relevant trade qualifications and a minimum of 2 years' experience as a Metal Fabricator/Fitter.

- Construction Safety Awareness - White Card
- Emergency Evacuation Drill
- Water Corporation Field Based Work Induction
- Water Corporation Level 1 Lock out Tag out (LOTO)

- Fire extinguisher training

Construction Estimator: To be considered for this position, you will need to have a minimum of three years estimating experience.

- Ability to read, understand and interpret engineering drawings and project documents
- A great communicator able to engage with internal and external stakeholders

Experience should include contractor management, earthworks, water management systems, quality assurance, and working within operational mining environments.   Location  Site Based, Remote NT Mine Site FIFO 15 working days, 13 rest days roster, 12 hour days Start Date ASAP - 4 months work with potential beyond that   Position Summary  The Civil Project Engineer is responsible for the planning, coordination, execution, and delivery of tailings storage facility (TSF) and associated infrastructure projects, ensuring all works are completed safely, on schedule, within budget, and in compliance with Glencore standards, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices. Working closely with operations, engineering consultants, contractors, and technical stakeholders, the Civil Project Engineer will oversee construction activities, manage project interfaces, and support the delivery of critical tailings infrastructure while maintaining the highest standards of safety, environmental stewardship, and quality.  Coordinate the execution of tailings storage facility construction and upgrades.

 Esential Qualifications  
 
 Bachelor of Engineering (Civil, Mining or related discipline).

 within the resources sector. 
 Experience managing bulk earthworks, embankment construction, water management infrastructure, 
 and associated civil works.

 Strong understanding of geotechnical and civil construction principles.

result.description: Growmore Partners Pty Ltd T/A FORMAL FINISH COATINGS  The Mechanical Engineering Technician (ANZSCO 312512) is responsible for supporting the installation, testing, maintenance, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of mechanical equipment and production systems used in the company's spray-painting and surface-finishing operations. The role ensures machinery operates safely, efficiently and reliably, minimising downtime while maintaining the company's high standards of quality, productivity and workplace safety.     The Mechanical Engineering Technician provides technical support for the maintenance and optimisation of production machinery, spray-painting systems, compressors, conveyors, curing equipment and other mechanical plant used throughout the coating process. Working closely with management and production personnel, the position assists in diagnosing equipment faults, implementing preventative maintenance programs, improving operational efficiency and ensuring compliance with Australian safety and engineering standards. The role contributes to the smooth delivery of high-quality coating solutions for commercial, industrial and residential projects.      DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES    •    Install, commission, inspect and maintain mechanical equipment used in spray-painting, coating and finishing operations.  •    Perform preventative maintenance on spray booths, compressors, pumps, conveyors, drying systems and associated mechanical equipment.  •    Diagnose mechanical faults, investigate equipment failures and carry out repairs to minimise production downtime.  •    Monitor machinery performance and recommend engineering improvements to increase operational efficiency and equipment reliability.  •    Assist engineers with testing, calibration and commissioning of new machinery and production equipment.  •    Prepare maintenance schedules, inspection reports, technical documentation and equipment service records.  •    Ensure all plant and machinery comply with workplace health and safety requirements, Australian Standards and company procedures.  •    Coordinate with suppliers and contractors regarding equipment servicing, spare parts procurement and technical support.  •    Support continuous improvement initiatives by analysing production data and recommending mechanical process enhancements.  •    Provide technical assistance to production staff on the safe and efficient operation of mechanical equipment.      QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS    •    AQF associate degree, Advanced Diploma or Diploma in Mechanical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering Technology, Engineering Technology or a closely related discipline, or an equivalent overseas qualification recognised in Australia (ANZSCO Skill Level 2).  •    Demonstrated experience in the installation, testing, maintenance, fault diagnosis and repair of mechanical equipment, machinery and production systems in an industrial or manufacturing environment.  •    Ability to interpret engineering drawings, technical specifications, schematics and maintenance manuals, with sound knowledge of mechanical, hydraulic and pneumatic systems.  •    Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to conduct equipment inspections, prepare technical reports and recommend improvements to enhance operational efficiency.  •    Sound understanding of Australian Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) requirements, engineering standards and preventative maintenance practices, with the ability to work effectively both independently and within a multidisciplinary team.  •    Experience in the spray-painting, surface finishing, manufacturing or industrial coating industry will be highly regarded.      WORKING HOURS    Full-time – 38 hours per week      BENEFITS    •    Competitive remuneration package.  •    Ongoing professional development and technical training.  •    Stable full-time employment.  •    Opportunity to work with modern industrial equipment and technologies.  •    Supportive and safety-focused work environment.  •    Career progression opportunities within the business.     About Company    GROWMORE PARTNERS PTY LTD, trading as FORMAL FINISH COATINGS, is a Victorian-owned specialist spray-painting and surface finishing company providing premium coating solutions for the shopfitting, cabinet making, construction and commercial fit-out industries. Operating from its purpose-built application facility in Campbellfield, the company delivers high-quality polyurethane coatings, custom colour matching, joinery finishes, glass splashbacks and specialised surface treatments using Australian-made materials. With extensive industry experience, Formal Finish Coatings has completed projects for commercial buildings, retail fitouts, airports and residential developments, earning a reputation for quality workmanship, reliability and exceptional customer service      Work Type:  Full time   Salary:  $80000-90000   Job Publish:  25-07-2026   Job Expire:  24-08-2026  Apply on:  Mechanical Engineering Technician Job here! result.description:
Field Service Technician
Premier Tech Systems and Automation Pty Limited
Full-time
130,000 – $140,000 (inclusive of guaranteed allowances) + super

The company

As part of the well-respected and successful international Premier Tech group, and with an
Australian history dating back to the 1950’s, we are a leader within the bulk handling and
packaging equipment industry in Australia.  We are collaborative and innovative, and we love
what we do.

The role

As part of a national team of field service technicians servicing and commissioning a range of
specialised flexible packaging machinery installed around the country and abroad, you will
travel extensively (approx. 75% of the role) throughout metro and regional VIC, as well as
interstate and the occasional international trip. 

Providing expert advice and service for robotic and conventional palletisers, bagging
machines, wrapping and hooding machines and their corresponding control systems, you
should expect to spend most of your time working on customer sites, with the remaining time
spent working between the West Heidelberg office and home.


JOB DESCRIPTION


Fundamental Duties and responsibilities 	

Perform in-house and on-site equipment installations and start-ups  
•	Install equipment at customers’ locations according to safety standards and established corporate procedures 
•	Perform initial start-ups for installed equipment
•	Test and verify installed equipment at customers’ locations
•	Perform tests and verify the proper functioning of equipment
•	Train customers on the proper operation of the equipment
•	Prepare reports on completed installations
•	Do in-house equipment start-ups before it leaves for customers’ locations

Solve various equipment problems for customers
•	Visit customers in order to diagnose equipment problems
•	Find solutions in collaboration with the engineering team
•	Adjust and repair customers’ equipment and ensure it is operated safely and according to the original specifications
•	Prepare reports following service calls
•	Contribute to product development

Do preventive equipment maintenance at various customers’ locations
•	Evaluate the safety, general state and compliance of various equipment
•	Do preventive maintenance and repair on equipment
•	Ensure proper equipment functioning following maintenance visits
•	Plan following maintenance visits as needed
•	Provide on-site and/or remote technical support to clients
•	Prepare reports on the work performed

Provide over the phone technical support for customers 
•	Diagnose problems and identify possible solutions for customers
•	Help customers find safe solutions to problems
•	Promote preventive maintenance and training services to customers

Other generic tasks as required
•	Preparing drawings, plans and designs for mechanical engineering work under the direction of Mechanical Engineers and Engineering Technologists
•	Assisting Mechanical Engineers and Engineering Technologists in the design of mechanical equipment and plant
•	Selecting tools and equipment
•	Assembling and installing new and modified mechanical assemblies, components, machine tools and controls, and hydraulic power systems
•	Estimating material costs and quantities, and machine requirements
•	Performing and directing field and laboratory tests
•	Collecting and analysing data, carrying out complex computations and preparing diagrams
•	Organising and supervising inspection and maintenance of machines and plant
•	Ensuring that designs and finished work are within specifications, regulations and contract provisions
•	Prepares detailed drawings and plans of mechanical engineering work in support of Mechanical Engineers and Engineering Technologists.
 


Advanced Duties and responsibilities 	

•	Assume responsibility for a certain type of service or equipment for customers
•	Do relatively complex installations at customers’ locations
•	Solve complex equipment problems for customers 
•	Provide over the phone technical support for customers 
•	Master preventive maintenance of equipment and suggest improvements to customers during service calls
•	Meet the demand for technical information from potential customers and promote Premier Tech products to customers 


•	Expert Duties and responsibilities 	

•	Be the go-to person for the team as work is carried out
•	Be an instructor and mentor for new team members
•	Collaborate in the equipment design process with the engineering team 
•	Help develop and implement work procedures and methods 
•	Organize installations or repair work to be done
•	Develop and provide specific technical service expertise to the team 
•	Apply different analysis and problem solving skills to diagnose and repair a variety of equipment  
•	Resolve unusual, major and complex problems on customers’ equipment
•	Do major and non-standard equipment installations at customers’ sites




 
COMPETENCIES PROFILE

Qualifications

At least a trade qualification, associate diploma in engineering or suitable equivalent mechanical/electrical/electronic/control automation qualification.

Technical competencies 	

•	In-depth specific knowledge of Premier Tech packaging machinery including Bottom-Up Filling Technology is highly desirable.
•	Interpreting mechanical and general assembly drawings
•	Interpreting hydraulic circuit drawings
•	Interpreting pneumatic circuit drawings
•	Interpreting electrical schematics
•	Interpreting general installation and industrial buildings layouts
•	Industrial PLC, networks and communication protocols
•	installation, commissioning and maintenance of industrial robots, packaging and powder conveying systems.
•	Installation and optimisation of pneumatically operated equipment
•	Installation, commissioning and troubleshooting of field devices and instrumentation
•	Installation and commissioning of industrial machinery safety systems and guarding.
•	Safe troubleshooting of partially energised systems
•	Troubleshooting PLCs programs, mechanical and electrical installations.
•	Systems and equipment start-up
•	Equipment preventative maintenance
•	Service reports generation
•	Training of machine Operators and Maintenance Crews
•	English communication


Culture

As a well-respected and successful business, we have a range of long term, loyal and
committed team members, creating a solid team environment and providing job security. We
work hard but always find time for a laugh. We care about our team and strive to be an
employer of choice!

What’s in it for you?

•	Competitive salary + travel allowance
•	A professional and friendly work environment
•	A hybrid work arrangement with opportunity to work from home or office (as required) when
•	not travelling
•	Fabulous Employee Assistance Program that includes telehealth appointments and
•	extends to immediate family members
•	On-going training and development.

How to apply

Please apply with a current CV and a separate cover letter outlining why you think
you are the right person for this opportunity.

Please note that only shortlisted applicants will be contacted and we thank you in advance for

Your new company     An exciting opportunity exists for an experienced Infrastructure Engineer to join a well-established technology services organisation with a growing presence in Tasmania.  Based in Hobart, this permanent role will see you supporting and improving enterprise Linux and cloud environments that underpin critical services across the state. Working closely with both local and national engineering teams, you'll play a key role in maintaining platform stability, security and operational excellence in mission-critical environments where availability and reliability are paramount.    Your new role     As an Infrastructure Engineer, you will be responsible for administering and supporting Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) environments, ensuring systems remain secure, available and performing at their best. You will manage patching and upgrades, monitor infrastructure health, respond to incidents, and contribute to ongoing platform improvement initiatives.  Working across Azure and AWS environments, you'll help strengthen infrastructure resilience, support security and compliance requirements, and participate in a 24/7 on-call roster. You'll take ownership of critical incidents from identification through to resolution, applying strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills while working within established change management and governance frameworks. You'll also be responsible for conducting root cause analysis and maintaining operational documentation and standards.    What you'll need to succeed   
 
 Mandatory RHCE (Red Hat Certified Engineer) certification 
 Strong experience administering enterprise Linux/RHEL environments 
 Infrastructure engineering experience within enterprise or managed services environments 
 Experience supporting Azure and/or AWS platforms 
 Strong troubleshooting, incident management and problem-solving skills 
 Experience with patching, upgrades, system hardening and vulnerability remediation 
 Strong communication skills and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively 
 The ability to pass a mandatory police check 
 
 Highly regarded: 
 
 Experience within utilities, critical infrastructure, OT environments or managed services 
 
  What you'll get in return     You'll join a growing Hobart engineering team backed by experienced national engineering resources across Australia. In return, you'll gain exposure to enterprise scale Linux and cloud environments, enjoy flexible hybrid working arrangements, receive an on-call allowance, and have the opportunity to further develop your career within a collaborative and technically focused organisation that values accountability, continuous improvement and technical excellence.
